raw:
That the criminal proceedings instituted against the Applicant are an abuse of the process of law, being instituted without lawful basis and with mala fide intent, thereby infringing the Applicant’s right to a fair trial. (Section 561A CrPC)

That, under Section 526 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, the High Court is empowered to set aside such proceedings and, at the option of the accused, direct that the proceedings be held afresh; the Applicant therefore seeks quash of the present proceedings. (Section 526 CrPC)
